name: WaterBench_Coast
description: WATER v4 bench #2 (docs/WaterRethink.md WP0-WP2, WP5). A streaming Perlin coastline at the engine-default sea level 16 - the ocean, the shore band, far water and the camera-walk probe. Recipe = the old WaterTest world (Water.md sec. 5): seed 20260804, whose documented shore rect (37,708)-(293,964) held 62,965 chunk-resident spans with every top at 16.0, and whose nearest sea from the dry highland spawn was at (165,16,890). Camera and player are placed AT THE SHORE, not the highland; poses marked PROVISIONAL are re-measured by `python tools/water_bench.py verify coast` and written back.

world._comment: streaming:true is required for the hydrology bake (lakes/rivers/sea levels) and for generation-time water spans. Radii as proving_grounds (224 u resident / 320 u unload).

water._comment: Default sea level 16 is MEASURED-correct for this seed (WaterTest: outlet TRUE, drainage complete, min terrain -24). Do not set seaLevel here; the recipe in world.db owns it after first boot.

camera._comment: MEASURED 2026-10-07 on this engine (terrain_height lines at x=100/165/230): the sand sits AT sea level (surface_y 16) from z~656 to z~672 and the seabed drops below 16 from z~676 northward, falling ~1 voxel per 20-25 u to y=3 at z=964 - a very gentle beach. The whole documented rect (37,708)-(293,964) is seabed. Spawn vantage looks north (+Z) over the beach to the sea.

player._comment: On the sand at sea level (surface_y 16), 16 u south of the waterline (z~676).

waterline._comment: First column north of which surface_y < 16 at x=165 (measured 2026-10-07). Trees stand on the beach at z 668-676 (surface_y 26-30 spikes).

expectSpans._comment: All-seabed rect, counted with the camera posed at the rect centre and unloaded == 0 (the count is residency-dependent otherwise: 66,004 vs 44,335 from two poses, 2026-10-07). Measured fully resident 2026-10-07: 66,004 spans / 81 chunks, every top 16.0; water_validate rim_leaks 257/257, worst 6 at (59,767) = the Water.md sec. 5 RED baseline reproduced exactly.

cameraProbe._comment: The two vantages the camera-walk probe diffs (Water.md sec. 8 #8b): far = horizon, near = shore_eye.

testVantages._comment: Poses measured against terrain_height on 2026-10-07; a screenshot per pose is owed before they are called final.

vantages.name: shore_eye
vantages.tests: Eye-level on the sand 12 u from the waterline: surf band, run-up, rim foam, the pull-away defect.

vantages.name: shore_elevated
vantages.tests: Beach + shallows + open sea in one frame; the reference look capture.

vantages.name: horizon
vantages.tests: Far water to the horizon: residency edge today (water stops where chunks stop), far-water tiles after WP2.
